name: _panel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_panel.scss — the expanding description panel under the cover:
//  .home-mosaic-bottom height transition, details block, and the draw-text
//  description with per-char draw animation.
//  Imported by home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// height is set inline by JS (0 → BOTTOM_H px)
.home-mosaic-bottom {
  // transition on height so panel animates smoothly
  transition:
    height 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.28s ease 0.1s;
  transition:
    height 0.52s $ease-spring,
    opacity 0.28s ease 0.1s;
  // Mobile: drop non-composited height transition, keep opacity only
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: opacity 0.28s ease 0.1s;
  }
  // Always dark to match card image aesthetic in both light and dark mode
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border-bottom-left-radius: inherit;
  border-bottom-right-radius: inherit;
  border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.07);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Card detail text block.
.home-mosaic-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg) 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // height is driven by parent (.home-mosaic-bottom), DO NOT set height here
}

// Card description.
.home-mosaic-desc {
  @extend %TXT_SM;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 200;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: rgba($color-white, 0.92);
  text-shadow: 0 var(--space-pixel) var(--space-2xs) rgba($color-black, 0.7);

  .draw-text__char {
    animation: char-draw 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 8ms));
  }
}
